items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and Bill Russell. ... [INTERVIEWEE] ...And Bill, you see. And then, uh, Bill, uh, then after we left there, then we made, uh, we made a band, and me and Willard Dennis Boyd, then we used to go play out there also.

ctx.x: St. Anne. And Ralph Collins is here, and Harold Dajon and Bill Russell. Would you mind giving your full name, Mr. Milton?
